role: A string set that serializes itself as a JsonArray of strings; used by the statistics save to store unlocked achievement/stat lists.
scope_reason: In scope: EntityPlayerMP.func_147098_j adds the player's biome to this set every 20 ticks while Adventuring Time is locked (server state; the delegate set ran in 44 recordings), and native ports the tracker (survival.c explored_count, surv_stats).

members.name: underlyingSet
members.note: explored: one bit per biome member (the first id of a biomeName)

members.name: func_152753_a
members.note: the stats file's progress list, as the snapshot's stats.json carries it

members.name: getSerializableElement
members.note: writes the stats file (StatisticsFile.func_150883_b at a save and the 900-tick autosave): a file on disk, not game state; native writes no save files (IntegratedServer's record: Java writes every checkpoint)

members.name: delegate
members.note: EntityPlayerMP.func_147098_j's add, and the achievement's all-biomes test
